test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Arun borrowed a sum of ₹9,000 from Jayanthi at 10% rate of compound interest per annum, compounded annually. Find the total amount paid by Arun after 2 years to clear all dues.
solution:
**Given :**

Principal value = Rs.9000

Interest rate = 10 % per annum

Time = 2 years

**Formula used :**

Amount (A) = P times (1 + {Rover 100})^n 

[Where, P = Principal value,

R = Annual interest rate,

n = Time in years]
